user.title: Sign in to Home-SmartLink
user.description: Use the email and password of the Home-SmartLink mobile app.

home.title: Choose a home
home.description: This account has access to several homes.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Home-SmartLink rejected the saved password for {email}. Enter the current password of the mobile app.

abort.wrong_account: These credentials give access to a different home.

init.title: Home-SmartLink options
init.description: Diagnoses make the box poll every thermostat, which refreshes the measured temperatures (results arrive about 1–2 minutes later). Set 0 to disable them.

command_failed.message: Home-SmartLink did not accept the command: {error}

set_program_slot.name: Set program slot
set_program_slot.description: Edits one of the six slots of an Advanced program. The heater uses the comfort temperature during active slots and the eco temperature otherwise.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Slot number, 1 to 6, as listed in the app.

end.name: End
end.description: After the start, multiple of 10 minutes.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days on which the slot is active (none disables it).

mode.name: Slot mode
mode.description: Keep empty to leave it unchanged.

set_simplified_program.name: Set simplified program
set_simplified_program.description: Edits the Morning and Evening hours and the days of a Simplified program. The Day range always spans from the end of Morning to the start of Evening. Omitted fields keep their current value.

morning_days.name: Morning days
morning_days.description: Days on which Morning heats at comfort temperature.

day_days.name: Day days
day_days.description: Days on which Day heats at comfort temperature.

evening_days.name: Evening days
evening_days.description: Days on which Evening heats at comfort temperature.
